description: Shared visual contract for MAQAN Platform, Atlas and WorldForge.
principles: Keep the spatial map and simulation data visually dominant.
Use flat near-black surfaces and restrained one-pixel separators.
Use cyan for active navigation and focus, not decorative framing.
Preserve semantic status colors for success, warning, danger and information.
Never replace source-backed data with illustrative placeholders.
Keep each module independently installable and its data ownership unchanged.
